Alex: heads-up — planning to flip the `inference_prefix_cache_v2` flag for EU tonight at 11pm UTC. who can click the toggle and own the smoke checks? :eyes:
Meera: I can take the flip if Sam or Jordan can be on-call for the 15m watch after. I'll do the smoke checklist and metric sanity.
Sam: I can stand by for 11-11:30 UTC. what are the must-verify metrics?
Meera: quick list: 1) p95 gen latency by model (all models), 2) 5xx rate, 3) queue depth on batchers, 4) error traces for KV-cache misses. also watch cost-per-token dashboard for any weird spike.
Jordan: i'll monitor infra alerts and have rollback ready. if p95 > baseline + 20% or 5xx > 0.5% for > 2min we rollback.
Priya: add a manual kill-switch in the toggle UI notes: rollback -> immediate. also confirm canary targets: start with 5% EU tenants, wait 10m, then 25%, then 100%.
Alex: that sounds good. Meera — can you paste the smoke commands you'll run?
Meera: sure — two quick intents: one short convo and one long streaming.
Meera: ```bash
# short response smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://eu-api.redwood.test/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-compat-small", "input":"summarize: quick smoke check"}'

# streaming / long context smoke
curl -sS -N -X POST https://eu-api.redwood.test/v1/stream 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-compat-medium", "input":"long-context smoke test ..."}'
```
Sam: i'll run a couple requests through the canary route once it's at 5% and validate outputs and latency.
Kai: i'll wire a temporary dashboard alert to page if p95 > baseline+15% during the window. adding a short runbook note: if alert fires, immediately pause rollout and ping #oncall-eng.
Jordan: log note — config will be rolled via config-orch job `flag-orch/flip-3308642000`. ensure `safe_default=true` is set so new tenants get old behavior until we increment exposure.
Alex: important — do not change quant profiles or batcher settings in the same window. keep to just the flag flip.
Priya: acknowledged. i'll post a quick public note in #general once 100% complete.
deploy-bot: Started rollout job flag-orch/flip-3308642000 -> canary 5% at 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z. CI checks: passed.
Meera: flipped to 5% now, running smoke now. pinging Sam for output validation.
Sam: smoke looks OK. p95 +3%, no 5xx. KV-miss rate stable.
Meera: moving to 25% in 10m. documenting times in the ticket.
Kai: alert silent so far. dashboard looks flat.
Jordan: holding on 25% for full 15m watch per plan. if still good, we proceed to 100%.
Alex: thanks all. quick reminder — rollback ready = who has permissions? Jordan has toggle rights and can revert immediately. Sam has infra rights to block the job if needed.
Priya: i'm updating the ticket with timestamps and who-clicked notes. will announce completion after 100% and 30m stability. :white_check_mark:
